Purpose and exclusions

Local screen/observer WBP_Minimap. Show authoritative results; never store canonical gameplay quantities.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Content Browser > Add > User Interface > Widget Blueprint > User Widget. Name WBP_Minimap under Content/Game/UI.
  2. Designer: use a size-constrained root panel, heading, status text, scrolling content, primary/cancel buttons and explicit focus order. Use TextBlock/FText, not untrusted rich HTML.
  3. Graph: on owner/model injection subscribe once to its result/change delegate, then immediately refresh. On Destruct or owner replacement unbind and clear references.
  4. Button OnClicked invokes the linked custom request command; show Pending and disable duplicate submissions until the same command resolves. Display stable localized rejection text and restore focus to originating control.
  5. Create through URPGScreenRouter with the local controller as Owning Player; Add to Viewport only locally. Opening this screen does not pause a shared zone.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Input, UMG screen ownership, options and accessibility. Rule owner: URPGScreenRouter. This asset’s role is Local screen/observer WBP_Minimap. Show authoritative results; never store canonical gameplay quantities.

  1. Enhanced Input local-player subsystem installs IMC_World only for the owning local player. A dedicated server has no UMG or local input setup.
  2. When inventory/dialogue opens, ScreenRouter saves focus and selects an explicit modal policy. The server world continues running.
  3. Widget button handlers call exposed request functions and immediately enter Pending; they never subtract wallet text or item quantities optimistically as committed facts.
  4. On accepted snapshot/receipt, update visible lists by stable item/quest identity and revision. On rejection show a localized reason and refresh affected data.
  5. On possession change, unbind old delegates, bind new PlayerState/components when ready, and perform one initial snapshot refresh.
  6. Travel/death/disconnect clears held actions and closes unsafe NPC/merchant/craft dialogs. Options may remain local, but no stale modal can issue a command against a new zone actor.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_FrontEnd and L_NetworkLab / Controller_A. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Open two modals repeatedly -> one well-defined top focus target, no duplicate delegates or RPCs.
Press confirm while request pending -> same command retry or no second request, never duplicate purchase.
Client opens Options during enemy attack -> world/other players continue; health still updates.
Close NPC UI during transfer -> old interaction token invalidated and focus restored after new possession.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not bind every frame, subscribe twice after possession, show Accepted before commit, trust client displayed currency or keep an old pawn reference after travel.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
